mostWorthwhile.text: Building and placing the traction panels was most worthwhile: the stiffness test and load-spreading explanation made their physical purpose clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Anchoring the winch and then combining it with the panels felt a little procedural, especially as each was the only offered action.

surprise.text: The distinction between framed panels and loose mesh clarified why the crossing could support the wheels rather than sink.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the winch anchor and supported panels each had an explained role, although the final combination was essentially a required follow-through.

continue.text: Yes. The physically explained crossing was satisfying, and I would be curious to see what the expedition finds beyond the wash.
